description: mod-ebsconet configuration template. Default values are calibrated against a reference bugfest environment (tebfcon-mod-ebsconet revision 14, image 2.5.0); see ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file. mod-ebsconet is a stateless HTTP adapter between EBSCONET and FOLIO orders: it has no database, no Kafka and no secret store, so it reads only the HTTP port, JVM options and logging configuration from the environment. Resource values and JVM limits must be adjusted to the target host capacity.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-ebsconet container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-ebsconet container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-ebsconet container in MiB

java.name: xmx
java.description: Maximum Java heap size. Value taken from bugfest; together with MaxMetaspaceSize it leaves about 290 MiB of the 1248 MiB container for code cache, thread stacks, GC structures and direct buffers

java.name: MaxMetaspaceSize
java.description: Maximum Java metaspace size. Value taken from bugfest. Metaspace is committed lazily, so the cap costs nothing unless it is used

java.name: MetaspaceSize
java.description: Initial Java metaspace size, i.e. the threshold at which the first metaspace garbage collection is triggered rather than a limit. Value taken from bugfest

deployment.description: mod-ebsconet is stateless: it has no database, no Kafka listeners, no caches and no scheduled jobs, and every request (GET/PUT /ebsconet/orders/order-lines/{polNumber}, GET /ebsconet/validate) is translated into calls to mod-orders, mod-organizations, mod-finance and mod-notes within that request. Replicas can therefore run side by side behind a load balancer without coordination. Two replicas are recommended for availability.

kong.description: Default Kong proxy timeouts are sufficient. Each request handles a single purchase order line and makes a small, bounded number of synchronous calls to other modules before responding.

EnvVars.name: SERVER_PORT
EnvVars.description: HTTP port the module listens on (Spring Boot server.port, 8081 in application.yaml). Must match the port in the sidecar's MODULE_URL

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options for the mod-ebsconet process (heap sizing from the java block, GC, agent flags, etc.). The module descriptor's Okapi launch configuration sets -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=80.0 here

EnvVars.name: LOG4J_CONFIGURATION_FILE
EnvVars.description: Location of an external Log4j2 configuration file, overriding the log4j2.properties bundled with the module. The module also bundles log4j2-json.properties for JSON-formatted logs, which can be selected with this variable

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the sidecar container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the sidecar container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the sidecar container in MiB

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Deployment environment identifier used by the sidecar. Must match the value used by the other modules and sidecars of the deployment

EnvVars.name: MODULE_NAME
EnvVars.description: Name of the backend module the sidecar fronts

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Internal URL (host:port) at which the mod-ebsconet container is reachable from its sidecar. The port must match the module's SERVER_PORT

EnvVars.name: MODULE_VERSION
EnvVars.description: Version of the mod-ebsconet module deployed alongside this sidecar
